$comment: Public, non-secret Robinhood Chain Mainnet deployment identity for clog.run. Tracked in git deliberately - see docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md for why (this exists specifically so a stale .env.production on the VPS can never silently override which deployment the frontend reads from after a git pull). Contains ONLY public contract addresses, chain id, and deployment block - never secrets, never a database URL, never a signer key. Edit this file (and only this file) to point the frontend at a different deployment; no other source file should ever hardcode a contract address.

$notReadByFrontend.$comment: Recorded for operational completeness and for scripts/verify-deployment.sh's own cross-contract/cross-chain checks. Never read by the Next.js app itself - see POST_DEPLOY_HANDOFF.md for exactly which five addresses (plus chainId/deploymentBlock) the frontend actually uses.

$verification.$comment: Independently verified on-chain via scripts/verify-deployment.sh, run by the operator against real RPC access to both chains (this repository's own preparation environment has no such access - see docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md). Every check passed: chain ids on both RPCs, code presence at all six addresses across both chains, every Robinhood-side cross-contract getter (TickerRegistry.eligibilityRegistry/.tickerNFT/.winnerPot, TickerNFT.tickerRegistry, RoundManager.engine/.randomnessProvider/.rewardVault, RewardVault.roundManager, EligibilityRegistry.roundManager, ChainlinkRandomnessProvider.roundManager/.wrapperOnArbitrum), the cross-chain VRFWrapperOnArbitrum.providerOnRobinhoodChain/.subscriptionId/.keyHash checks, and deploymentBlock itself - resolved and confirmed from the real TickerRegistry deployment transaction's own receipt (status=success, contractAddress matches this file's tickerRegistry exactly, blockNumber matches the operator's independently-supplied EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_BLOCK exactly), never merely accepted from a claimed value.
$verification.verifiedBy: operator, via scripts/verify-deployment.sh against live Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum One RPC endpoints
